scope: Adopt exactly the three reviewed finite parameterized source goals; preserve all existing identities and runtime/mode gaps.

adoptedGoals.name: 按编号选择工作区标签
adoptedGoals.rationale: Workspace tab selection by ordinal is distinct from editing the shortcut preference, selecting a sidebar thread by ordinal, and adjacent-thread navigation.
behavior: jc maps Ti into Lc(commandId, index, mainTabPanelId); Lc registers Ln(commandId, callback).
Hji chooses the eligible tab list from split/layout state; a numeric index reverses in RTL. An absent target returns false.
Hji calls VW(store,target), optionally schedules focus with requestAnimationFrame, and returns true. VW/state providers and actual DOM outcomes remain delegated.
Lc calls dc only after Hji returns true. dc is a one-time shortcut migration notice with its own trigger, preference and custom-binding guards; the notice is not the tab-switch operation.
conditions: 保留jc实际挂载条件与同ID命令优先级。
数组索引按源生产顺序映射；布局、split和RTL决定实际候选及位置。
dc提示有独立触发来源、偏好、覆盖绑定与一次性状态条件。
knownGaps: Mount eligibility and full Codex/Chat mode closure.
Actual VW receiver/state and focus outcomes, multiple-window behavior and restoration.

adoptedGoals.name: 执行当前线程的本地环境动作
adoptedGoals.rationale: Running an action for the current thread is distinct from choosing, editing or saving the environment configuration.
behavior: The selected HS branch mounts JS only with conversation, environment and config, and when registerCommands is truthy.
YS enables its registered command only when actionItem and conversationId exist; its callback invokes the supplied onRunAction(actionItem).

HS resolves cwd with ZS; missing cwd or conversation logs and returns. It updates the selected action preference, derives the terminal ID, shows the terminal, then delegates et.runAction with command/cwd/title.
YS also supplies a workspace command-menu item labelled codex. Its selected callback runs onRunAction before closing that menu. This label does not establish whole-feature mode ownership.
US can create runId=environmentAction10 and later for extra action items, with commandId=null. Nine command IDs do not cap the number of configured actions.
conditions: 动作先经tC按平台筛选，按筛选后原顺序登记；槽位缺动作或会话时不启用。
cwd或会话缺失时记录错误并返回。
knownGaps: tC platform eligibility and ZS resolution are delegated boundaries.
Actual et.runAction backend, execution outcome, failure/cancel/restart and durable preference effects.
Full mount and Codex/Chat mode closure.

adoptedGoals.name: 切换页面编辑器的列表样式
adoptedGoals.rationale: No existing finite goal names this editor list-style toggle. File open/search/review and page navigation do not establish the same operation; no merge is inferred.
behavior: Jr supplies canWrite only when access.can_write===true, together with editorView and isPageActive.
Wr registers _t(command.id, callback, options): enabled=canWrite; isActive rejects destroyed, noneditable or composing editors and delegates the active-page predicate.
keyboardHandler returns false when editorView lacks focus and undefined when focused, allowing the existing Pw fallback behavior.
zr returns without selection on destroyed editors; otherwise it delegates Rr(editorView,ar(editorView)).select(style,"toggle","preserve").
conditions: 注册options保留未销毁、可编辑、不处于composing、页面active与键盘焦点要求。
元数据里的commandMenuFeature=chatgpt只说明菜单标签，尚不证明整条编辑器功能的模式闭包。
knownGaps: Page mount, access and full Codex/Chat mode closure; unknown remains retained.
Rr/ar editor implementation, transaction/history/persistence effects and actual focus behavior.
